name: Coronal Rain
desc: An arcade of magnetic loops standing off the limb in the extreme ultraviolet, glowing hardest at the feet where the heating is — until an apex loads up with too much mass to stay hot, catastrophically cools, and condenses into blobs that cannot fall straight down because they are threaded on the field, so they hang at the top where gravity along the field line is zero, creep, and then plunge into whichever leg they happened to condense on, while the loops themselves ring in the kink mode and the diffuse corona drifts around them.

energy.doc: how hard the active region is driven — loop height and glow, the diffuse corona around it, the gravity the drops feel along the field, and how many of them condense (the master knob)

scale.doc: arcade size — a low huddle of small arches on the horizon, or loops that walk off the top of the frame

speed.doc: time rate (0.15 still drains, hangs and rings — just slowly)

density.doc: how many loops in the arcade, how far it spreads along the limb, and how much rain is falling through it

shear.doc: arcade shear — 0.5 stands the loops straight up, either extreme leans the whole arcade over the way a sheared field does before it erupts

hue.doc: passband tone (40 = the gold of the 171-angstrom channel); euv_teal, schematic and xray set their own on purpose

x.doc: where the active region sits along the limb

y.doc: height of the limb in the frame — how much of the mossy disk you see under the arcade

style.doc: aesthetic: gold 171-angstrom plate / green-teal 193-angstrom plate / deep-crimson H-alpha hedgerow / abstracted cyan drafting blueprint — the loops reduced to field-line curves on a drafting ground with the drops as bright ticks / austere greyscale soft X-ray where the rain is cool and reads as dark absorbing knots

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the arcade geometry, kink phases and where every drop condenses
